MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The heat shrink tubing fits my small electronics work because it would help insulate exposed connections when I move beyond temporary breadboard wiring.",
    "The solder seal connectors could help secure those connections if the wire sizes fit, while the digital caliper would help check component and mounting dimensions. These are practical next steps for the projects suggested by my history."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The heavy battery lugs are electrical parts, but their large cable size does not fit the small battery holders and breadboard wiring I have used.",
    "The three filament choices assume a printer and a printing project that my history does not establish. The thick acrylic sheet and feeler gauge also lack a specific current purpose for me.",
    "Another caster set resembles my latest interaction, but I would need a replacement or a second project before choosing it."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in electronics seems to have been stretched into an assumed interest in 3D printing, even though those activities require different equipment and supplies.",
    "Similarity to something I have already used seems to count too much without considering whether I need another one or whether the size suits my work."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My battery holder, mini breadboards, PCB kit and relay point toward small component projects, where wire size and compatibility matter more than a broad electrical connection.",
    "I am more likely to choose something with a clear job in an existing project, such as insulating wiring, than materials that require an unestablished project or equipment."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my small electronics work but stretched it into unsupported printing needs and repeat hardware purchases."
}
